newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican retail, wholesale sales drop in February.
newsitem.headline: Mexican retail, wholesale sales drop in February.

text.p: Mexican wholesale sales fell 0.1 percent in February compared with the same month last year, and the combined retail sales decline for the first two months of the year was 3.4 percent, the National Statistics Institute (INEGI) said on Friday.

INEGI gave no figure for the retail sales decline in February, but according to Reuters calculation from the survey, the decline was 3.29 percent. Both figures were substantially worse than analysts had predicted.
In the Reuters survey, analysts had expected an average drop of 0.46 percent in retail sales and a rise of 2.73 percent in wholesale sales.
INEGI gave no reason why it excluded the February retail sales figure. In its index, retail sales dropped from 69.9 in February 1996 to 67.6 in February 1997.
It said the drop in wholesale sales was partly because in the second month of the year "there were a lower number of working days than in February 1996, which was a leap year."
The INEGI report said that purchases by wholesalers rose 2.4 percent in the first two months of the year. It gave no percentage change for purchases by retailers.
